description: List the sessions open for this API key, to recover a session_id you've lost or to see how many are open before create_session. Returns {sessions: [{id, documentId, libraryFileId, createdAt, updatedAt, sheetCount, memBytes}]}, times in epoch milliseconds; closed and expired sessions are left out. Pass an id to any session tool, or to close_session to free a slot. Takes no arguments. Each API key can hold 5 open sessions, and a session closes on its own after 30 minutes without a call.
name: list_sessions
title: List sessions
